patthana24.19:1.1: na saraṇo na sappaccayo dhammo araṇassa sappaccayassa dhammassa …pe… ekaṃ. nasaraṇaduka nasaṅkhataduke saraṇaduka saṅkhatadukaṃ
patthana24.19:2.1: na saraṇo na saṅkhato dhammo. saṅkhittaṃ.
patthana24.19:3.1: nasaraṇaduka nasanidassanaduke saraṇaduka sanidassanadukaṃ na saraṇaṃ na sanidassanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo sanidassano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.19:5.1: na saraṇaṃ na sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.19:7.1: na saraṇaṃ na rūpiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo rūpī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā dve.
patthana24.19:8.1: na saraṇaṃ na arūpiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā saraṇo arūpī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā dve. nasaraṇaduka nalokiyaduke saraṇaduka lokiyadukaṃ
patthana24.19:9.1: na saraṇaṃ na lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana24.19:10.1: na saraṇaṃ na lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paccayā araṇo lokuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ. nasaraṇaduka nakenaciviññeyyaduke saraṇaduka kenaciviññeyyadukaṃ
patthana24.19:11.1: na saraṇaṃ na kenaciviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo kenaciviññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.19:12.1: na saraṇaṃ na kenacinaviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo kenacinaviññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nasaraṇaduka naāsavagocchakaduke saraṇaduka āsavagocchakadukaṃ
